params.name: searchQuery
params.description: The text query to search for matching locations.

params.name: category
params.description: Filter results by location category type.

params.name: phone
params.description: Phone number to search for a specific location.

params.name: address
params.description: Address string to improve search accuracy.

params.name: latLong
params.description: Latitude and longitude pair to bias search results toward a specific geographic area. Format is latitude,longitude.

params.name: radius
params.description: The radius distance from the latLong point to filter results.

params.name: radiusUnit
params.description: The unit of measurement for the radius parameter.

params.name: language
params.description: The language code for the response content. Tripadvisor supports 29 languages.

items.docs: Returns up to 10 locations found by the given search query. You can use category, phone number, address, and latitude/longitude to search with more accuracy. Locations include hotels, restaurants, and attractions.

items.docs: Returns up to 10 locations found near the given latitude and longitude. You can use category, phone number, and address to search with more accuracy. Useful for finding hotels, restaurants, and attractions in proximity to a specific geographic point.
